title: Ground-State Energy Calculation of Metallic Hydrogen Using Local Density Approximation (LDA)

contributions.purpose: 用Kohn-Sham DFT+LDA算金属氢基态能
contributions.mechanism: Julia平面波基组+经验赝势+Perdew-Zunger交换关联,简单立方晶格
contributions.evaluation: 未报任何基态能数值(只给收敛阈值Ecut<2e-4 Ry等)
contributions.source_quote: We implement a plane-wave basis set method in Julia, incorporating an empirical pseudopotential and the Perdew-Zunger parameterization for exchange-correlation

contributions.mechanism: 对Ecut与k点密度收敛研究;均匀电子气动能与Ewald求和校验
contributions.evaluation: 仅校验偏差:动能|Δ|=6.67e-4 Ha,Ewald对α独立到1e-6 Ha;rs=1.0/1.4/1.8的产出能量缺失
contributions.source_quote: the calculation of the uniform electron gas kinetic energy adheres strictly to known analytical values, exhibiting a deviation of |∆|= 6.67×10−4Ha

notes: 无编号贡献列表,由abstract+conclusion归纳2条。数据红旗突出:①abstract明写'The following results are all generated by AI and have not been verified by humans',checklist全[D];②幻影结果:全文核心承诺算rs=1.0/1.4/1.8基态能,但Experiments/Conclusion从未给出任一基态能数值或能量分解表,只剩校验偏差与大段套话(结果缺席);③LLM元评论残留留在正文:'In this subsection, I refined the provided draft on "Production Calculations"...'、'This subsection expands on the provided draft...';④引用堆砌129条,大量electron-proton散射/Wigner随机矩阵/量子光学等与金属氢DFT无关文献。type=method。
